## Structured data

Plumber (LocalBusiness subtype) JSON-LD, validated with a schema validator on 2026-10-10.

## Performance budget

| Metric | Budget | Measured | Tool |
|---|---|---|---|
| LCP | under 2.5 s | 1.6 s | PageSpeed Insights, mobile |

| Event | Fires when | Verified in tool |

## Redirect map

Every changed URL in audit/url-map.csv has a 301 in place and was tested: single hop, lands on a 200 page.

## Deploy

Deployed to the static host on 2026-10-12 by the owner's developer, after Gate 3 approval.

## Post-deploy checks

Live URL loads, a test booking arrived, events arrive, the page is indexable, and the sitemap was submitted in Search Console.
